I only take one puff! #mrsfisher.Face.Normal Mrs. Fisher: True, but someone has to finish the rest of it. You: Then how is it my fault if you smoke like 99% of it?! You: I seriously doubt that… Mrs. Fisher: Are you going to smoke or not? I want to go back to fishing already. You: Yes I do… You: Cough, cough, cough!
